expected_behavior: Offline verification of a workflow edit uses the validator meta contract plus an evaluation of the extracted meta export; a whole-file node syntax check is named as invalid because the Workflow runtime wraps the body, which is what makes top-level return legal there.
observation: A whole-file node syntax check rejects the workflow at the body top-level return statement, and it does so identically on unmodified committed bytes and on edited bytes, so the obvious offline instrument reports a failure that is not the editor's change and reads as a break in the fleet's only workflow, which already has a history of load failures.
